interfaces.description: List of physical and virtual interfaces to configure with optional attributes.

type.description: Interface type (e.g., eth, vlan, loopback). Optional.

loopback.description: If true, create a loopback interface (lo) with a default description.

log_file.description: Path to the Zebra log file.

router_id.description: Router ID in dotted decimal (e.g., 192.0.2.1). Required for multi-router deployments.

redistribute.description: List of protocols to redistribute into Zebra (e.g., static, kernel, connected, bgp, ospf).

type.description: Protocol type to redistribute (e.g., static, kernel, connected, bgp, ospf, rip). Required.

route_map.description: Route-map name to filter or modify redistributed routes. Optional.

enable.description: Enable password (plaintext or hashed, depending on 'enable secret' config elsewhere). Optional.

vty.description: VTY access password. Optional but recommended.

vty_access.description: List of VTY access control entries. Each entry defines which hosts or subnets may connect via VTY.

hosts.description: List of allowed hosts or subnets.

zebra_options.description: List of additional Zebra-specific configuration lines (e.g., 'ipv6 forward', 'no ip forward'). Use with caution.
